summary.ja: 多電子配置の展開と打切りの意味を整理する。
summary.en: Explain many-electron configuration expansions and truncation.

references.label: Knowles, P. J.; Handy, N. C. (1984), A new determinant-based full configuration interaction method
references.scope: Primary publication entry point for the quantum-chemistry overview. Bibliographic/introductory review only; full-paper equations and numerical results have not been reproduced.

assumptions: Introductory formulation and comparison, not a verified executable solver.
Representative electronic-structure formulas use nonrelativistic Born–Oppenheimer theory unless the section explicitly states otherwise.

Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function.

Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree.
units: Atomic units: energies hartree, nuclear positions bohr; the explicit finite AO space is fixed.
boundary_conditions: The fixed case-specific conditions only; no general materials or long-MD validation.

next_deliverable.ja: 固定した教育用例を保持し、一般範囲への拡張は必要性が改めて指定された場合に別途扱う。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain these fixed educational examples; broader extensions require a separately specified need.

limitations.ja: 2固定距離のみ。有限基底FCIは連続空間の厳密解ではなく、UHF定常解の一般的な大域最小性は保証しません。角運動量・完全基底・広い解離曲線は未検証。 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
limitations.en: Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested. Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

metadata_review.level: Release-specific small educational examples; inspect the versioned source and independent-extraction evidence. Broad method scope remains limited.

prior_reading_metadata.level: curated introductory formulation with primary publication and official-documentation entry points; full derivation audit and numerical examples pending

assumptions_ja: 定式化と比較の導入解説であり、実行・検証済みソルバーではありません。
代表式は、各節に別記する場合を除き非相対論・Born–Oppenheimerの電子状態問題を想定します。
H-H距離1.4/3.0bohr、2電子、HごとにSTO-3G縮約s軌道を1個用います。 核間距離1.4/3.0bohr、全エネルギーhartree。各Hに同じ明示3primitiveのs型収縮を1つ置く2AO/2電子の固定部分空間。
H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。
units_ja: 原子単位：エネルギーhartree、核座標bohr。明示した有限AO部分空間を固定します。
boundary_conditions_ja: 各固定例の条件に限定し、一般物質・長時間MDを検証しません。

caution.ja: 独立な演算子組立と2電子RS2恒等式で固定小模型を照合します。新しい外部PySCF参照はありません。一般分子DFT、CC、多参照法、精密エネルギー・最適化・化学精度は未実装/未検証。MP2は変分上界ではありません。
caution.en: Independent operator assembly and two-electron RS2 identity qualify this fixed toy. No fresh external PySCF scalar. General molecular DFT, CC, multireference methods, precision energetics, geometry optimization and chemical accuracy remain unimplemented/unverified. MP2 is not variational.

title.ja: 最小基底H2のRHF/UHF/FCI・2固定幾何
title.en: Minimal-basis H2: RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI

summary.ja: 同じ最小基底H2の2固定幾何で、RHF/UHF/有限基底FCIとスピン対称性を比較します。
summary.en: Compare RHF, broken-spin UHF and finite-basis FCI for H2 at two fixed geometries in the same minimal basis.

assumptions.ja: H-H距離1.4/3.0bohr、2電子、HごとにSTO-3G縮約s軌道を1個用います。 核間距離1.4/3.0bohr、全エネルギーhartree。各Hに同じ明示3primitiveのs型収縮を1つ置く2AO/2電子の固定部分空間。
assumptions.en: Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function.

algorithm.ja: 固定SCFでRHFと対称性を破ったUHFを求め、4x4二電子Hamiltonianを対角化します。
algorithm.en: Run fixed SCF and diagonalize the4x4 two-electron Hamiltonian using the unchanged explicit H STO-3G contraction.

validation.ja: 保存PySCF RHF2値、独立g/u変分多項式・FCI閉形式・fermion組立と照合します。
validation.en: Check two saved PySCF RHF energies, an analytic paired g/u variational polynomial, the even2x2 FCI block and independent fermion assembly.

limits.ja: UHFはスピン混入を持ちます。2幾何だけで完全な解離曲線や連続空間の厳密解を保証しません。
limits.en: Only two H2 geometries and two contracted s orbitals; no complete-basis dissociation curve. UHF is spin contaminated; FCI exactness is finite-basis only.

review.ja: 公式文書のFC=SCε、平均場・行列式、RHF/UHF、定常性と安定性、重なりの直交化を選択閲読。PySCF実行は行いません。
review.en: FC=SCe, mean-field orbital/determinant ansatz, stability vs stationarity, RHF/UHF spin symmetry and overlap orthogonalization selected passages. No PySCF execution.

review.ja: 公式CI文書の導入とFCIのスピン区分・行列式の例を選択閲読。章全体や実装全体の監査ではありません。
review.en: Introduction and FCI/spin-sector examples: all determinants within a finite symmetry sector, diagonalization, Nalpha/Nbeta. Not full chapter or full package source.

title.en: A tiny three-center H3+ RHF / MP2 / FCI example

summary.ja: 固定三角形H3+の3中心小分子で、RHF/MP2/有限基底FCIを示します。
summary.en: Demonstrate RHF, MP2 and finite-basis FCI for a tiny fixed three-center H3+ molecule.

assumptions.ja: H核3個、電荷+1、2電子、3縮約s軌道の非対称三角形1個です。 H3+の固定3中心[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr、電荷+1、2電子/3s軌道。エネルギーhartree。
assumptions.en: Two electrons/3 explicit s orbitals, one fixed non-symmetric triangle. Molecular DFT, CC and general multireference/large molecules remain unimplemented tails. One H3+ geometry[(0,0,0),(1.5,0,0),(.5,1.5,0)]bohr, charge+1,2electrons/3s orbitals; energies in hartree.

algorithm.ja: 正準RHFから2電子MP2と9x9 FCIを求め、保存軌道から密度の2D断面を描画します。
algorithm.en: Canonicalize RHF, evaluate the two-electron MP2 correction and9x9 FCI, and render the saved occupied-orbital density slice.

validation.ja: 独立fermion組立、MP2行列要素の摂動式、電子数・SCF残差・FCI変分性を確認します。
validation.en: Check independent signed-fermion assembly, determinant perturbation MP2, electron number, SCF stationarity and FCI variational ordering.

limits.ja: 一般分子DFT・CC・一般多参照法は未実装です。MP2は変分的でなく、外部独立エンジンの新参照値も生成しません。
limits.en: General molecular DFT, CC, large bases and general multireference methods remain unimplemented. Independent operator assembly is not an independent external chemistry-engine scalar reference.
